Domain predecessor #58 is independently accepted and integrated at exact6113ca55b57cb628b016c483070dbb52cd5dd79a. Source CI34033181820 and canonical integration push CI34033772732 each passed18 applicable jobs plus one explicit M3 helper SKIP. M1 is already complete. The Master completion/parallel-surface kickoff checkpoint precedes worker dispatch; all143 baseline findings stay open.

Parent #21; M2 Application api/ports leaf contribution, dispatched only after accepted M1 and Domain integration. Master records exact base/source/CI authority when opening this Issue. Read full AGENTS.md/developmentInstructions, #21/this Issue, accepted REFDES/API/MigrationMap/Slices/Verification and all seven FROZEN 1.0.0 BCs plus BoundaryTypes--001/BCFreeze--001 completely. The later frozen declarations specialize the accepted design. Actual Domain implementation and its independently accepted exact SHA are now the shared input, not duplicated local identities.

Fresh Worker owns new internal/application/api/ and internal/application/ports/ plus local deterministic tests/README and bounded worker report. No Application coordinator/usecases, concrete adapters, legacy files, State/View, module/workflow or frozen contract/design edits. No product PR, integration merge, tag or publication. Master owns traceability and supplies separate independent Reviewer.

Deliver all concrete compile surfaces required by the frozen set, not only types needed by one adapter: shared distinct IDs/opaque versions/observations/pages/options/diagnostics/effects/recovery; closed public Client request/correlation/receipt/event/confirmation/command/query/result/read-model inventory; exact scope/binding/cwd/invocation values; Git facts/preparation/results/continuations, GitHub remote/PR observations, Persistence whole documents/field-presence/unknown JSON/load/commit/recovery results, Launch Discovery saved/discovered/ordered selection types and Runtime invocation/session/output/lifecycle/shutdown records. Ports owns all exact declared interfaces and private issued plan/receipt/load wrappers; public opaque SourceVersion/StorageVersion and event cursor aliases follow BoundaryTypes. API cannot import ports; ports cannot expose adapter DTOs. Viewmodel stays a separate State-owned leaf.

Use the accepted validated private or sealed representations and deep copies. Preserve explicit absence/typed nil handling, incompatible version domains, exact scope and immutable revision authority, separate operation/source/session/intent sequences, shared LocalConfiguration effect and exact Git reconciliation subset. StorageRecovery shared IDs and family details survive result-plus-error/normalization; no generic map/any dispatcher or backend object/native handle/callback/reader crosses the value surface. Whole-document unknown-member/Absent/Null/Present semantics stay lossless without JSON tags in Domain. No implicit filesystem/process/network/clock activity in API constructors.

Port-issued Git plans/receipts keep issuer lifetime, operation, kind, version/token and group/step distinct without adding native resource ownership to value DTOs. Constructors alone do not imply real Git registry validation or user approval; those are future adapter/Application gates. Complete all required names/request-result pairs, including ObserveStatus, MergeBase, ReadStashPatch, commit final-index-versus-tree facts, prepared continuation evidence, independent upstream outcomes, Runtime reliable cleaned-event/ACK values and aggregate cleanup. Do not invent a convenience facade that bypasses the contracts.

Meaningful tests cover invalid/mismatched request/variant/scope/correlation, exact target retained, nested mutation after constructor/getter/clone, foreign plan issuer/kind/operation and explicit absence; all defined interface signatures compile with narrow external conformance fixtures. Demonstrate error-plus-known-effects/recovery values can be retained without loss. Test import/public-type purity through M1 checker for all twelve platform selections. Full coordinator exactly-once/admission/cleanup, real adapter and end-to-end behavior remain later work, never a claim based on these leaf tests.

Freeze/push exact worker HEAD, report actual tests/race/build/checker/CI and limits; separate reviewer inspects actual source/tests/contracts, correct/re-review, require configured branch CI, then Master serially integrates. An insufficient frozen signature or invariant requires BC-CHANGE and affected pause before changing it; no layer-local alias/workaround. All13 Slices remain selected and no complete Slice/product finding is closed by compilation alone.

Independent read-only surface inventory found no material frozen signature/ownership contradiction. Completeness gate: five Client methods,28 distinct command/result semantics,13 query families,six closed event alternatives; seven port interfaces with48 exact methods. Commands: ActivateWorktree, SaveNavigation, CreateWorktree, RetargetWorktree, Deploy, CreateBranch, Fetch, Pull, Push, StagePaths, UnstagePaths, StageAll, Commit, StageAllAndCommit, RestoreTracked, StashCreate, StashApply, StashPop, StashDrop, CreatePullRequest, SaveLaunch, StartLaunch, OpenTerminal, WriteInput, ResizeSession, InterruptSession, StopSession, RestartSession. Queries: Navigator, BranchContext, Commits, Graph, Diff, PullRequestDiff, WorktreeStatus, Stashes, StashPatch, LaunchPoints, Sessions, SessionOutput, Preferences. Events: Accepted, Progress, ConfirmationRequested, OperationTerminal, SessionChanged, ProjectionInvalidated. Port method inventory:
- GitFacts: ResolveLocal, ListWorktrees, ObserveStatus, ResolveExact, ListRefs, ListStashes, ReadStashPatch, MergeBase, ReadCommits, ReadGraph, ReadDiff.
- GitMutations: PrepareCreate, PrepareRetarget, PrepareStage, PrepareCommit, PrepareRestore, PrepareStash, PrepareBranch, PreparePush, ExecutePrepared, ReleasePlan, Fetch, Reconcile.
- RemoteFacts: ResolveRepository, ListBranches, ListPullRequests, ObservePullRequest.
- RemoteMutations: CreatePullRequest.
- LaunchDiscovery: Discover, Resolve.
- Storage: LoadUserConfig, LoadPreferences, LoadRunConfig, CommitUserConfig, CommitPreferences, CommitRunConfig.
- Sessions: Start, Snapshot, List, ReadOutput, Write, Resize, Interrupt, Stop, Restart, NextEvent, AckEvents, Shutdown.

Preserve all15 shared diagnostic codes,nine independent effect facets and five effect states; Git Reconcile accepts exactly its seven allowed shared facets. OpaqueJSON json.Valid alone does not establish UTF-8, duplicate-key, depth, known-name-collision or whole-document validity; combine appropriate pure value/document checks with Persistence's strict codec ownership. No API decoder/encoder or checker relaxation is authorized. Among specified known document fields only StripPrefixes accepts Null. Constructor/file-layout details remain ordinary implementation choices within the frozen contracts. Actual accepted Domain is private tagged Head/ExactTarget, with constructors/accessors documented in internal/domain/README.md; consume it directly, do not duplicate it.

comments.body: Kickoff checkpoint29a12cbd6f2a0e189439b9ca25889f9f566afd6c is committed/pushed before implementation. Domain #58 is complete/closed; exact6113ca5 source and integration CI gates pass. M2-Surfaces--001, current sprint/index/relations/ledger42 and frozen BCs govern this contribution. Application worker owns only new internal/application/api and ports plus local tests/README and bounded Application/M2-API--001.md report, branch codereview-21/layer-application-api. The two leaves may run in parallel because viewmodel has no API/ports dependency. Each freezes for a separate fresh reviewer/current CI; Master integrates API/ports then viewmodel serially. No program metadata/shared/frozen contract edits or full-Slice/baseline finding closure is delegated.
